4. Provide estimated total payable amount. Possibly include insurance? Not specified. So just flight cost.

It just needs travel_from, travel_to, travel_date, travel_class. So we can call get_flight_cost without authentication. Good.

So we can call list_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. Then provide estimate.

Thus we need to call list_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. Then respond.

Let's do that.
